name: io.github.WYRE-AI/kaseya-quote-manager-mcp
title: Kaseya Quote Manager
description: Read-only MCP server for Kaseya Quote Manager (Datto Commerce): quotes, orders, purchasing.

environmentVariables.name: KASEYA_QUOTE_MANAGER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Kaseya Quote Manager API key (Settings → API). Sent in the apiKey header.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode for the server. Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: HTTP credential source: 'gateway' (default when unset) expects the X-Kaseya-Quote-Manager-Api-Key header from the WYRE AI gateway; 'env' reads KASEYA_QUOTE_MANAGER_API_KEY. Any other value refuses to start. Stdio ignores this.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
